task: Monte Carlo evaluation of QD-GMM (quasi-differenced GMM for policy effects on a transmission scale) and comparators; theory/simulation_spec.md (ADEMP)
dataset: simulated county-week epidemic panels (25 pre-specified scenarios; src/dgp.py, src/scenarios.py); application: US county COVID-19 cases and state mask orders (data_contract.md)

seeds.rule: seed = 20261112 + scenario_id * 100000 + rep; streams [seed, 0] structure, [seed, 1] innovations; population psi pairs use seed + 900000000

statistics.mcse: Morris, White & Crowther (2019); `std` in summary cells is the across-replication sd of the error (bias), of the 0/1 indicator (coverage, reject0) or null where the measure is itself a dispersion; `mcse` is given in every cell

simulated_note: false = every number was produced by actually running this code (Monte Carlo study and real-data application); the experiment-suite 'simulated' flag denotes placeholder numbers, which are not used anywhere. The Monte Carlo data sets are synthetic by design (src/dgp.py).

provenance.source: Monte Carlo run of src/simulate.py, rows sim/rows.jsonl, aggregated by src/aggregate.py

supplementary.note: M0_GI is a post-hoc addition (run-sim-application, experiment_design.md deviation 7), fitted by src/simulate_supp.py on the same seeds/data sets; its measures use the replications it reached (scenarios[sid].supp_R)

notes: Partial runs are aggregated as they stand: each scenario reports its own R and each measure its own denominator (n_ok, n_se). M0_G inference for phi is undefined when the selected solution is the boundary phi = 0 (se = null); its phi coverage is computed over interior selections only (n_se). psi values are sums over county-weeks and can be very large in scenarios with explosive growth.

source.what: generation time, Weibull (Ferretti et al. 2020, Science 368:eabb6936, Table 1)
serial interval, lognormal, mean 4.7 d, SD 2.9 d (Nishiura, Linton & Akhmetzhanov 2020, Int J Infect Dis 93:284-286)

average_e0_to_e5.weights: equal over single-week bins, open-ended last bin excluded

lead_placebo.note: conventional lead placebo; not a valid test under feedback (Proposition 2(c))

application.kansas_subset: not run: the CDC file codes state orders only; Kansas county opt-outs are not coded
